title: Hold a security business licence
what: Hold the state's security business (or agent) licence before providing security services, and use only licensed staff.

sources.title: Security and Investigations Agents Act 2002 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not undertake any commercial agent activities, crowd control agent activities, security agent activities or inquiry agent activities unless the person is – (a) the holder of an agent licence

reach.note: Security activities; investigation and locksmith work are licensed separately or not at all.
